overview_description.description:
Autobia is a B2B marketplace leveraging the data to solve the infrastructure and after-sales challenges in the automotive industry. The company bridges the gap between wholesalers and resellers by offering in-between digital, operational and logistical integrated solutions.

It was founded in 2021 and is located in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.
